schema.ownership: balanced_owners; connected exact seven-flag signature; minimum original descendant ordering
schema.W: binary original corner-mid subedges; symmetric quotient cut multiplicities; no RBE shortcuts
schema.R: hard aggregate mass restriction; original volume/10 proxy; row coarse dst, column fine src
schema.P: complete two Jacobi passes J^2G; omega2/3; row fine dst, column coarse src
schema.P_resource_guard: Original helper rejects >64 average nnz at either pass; no truncation, topk or support pruning
schema.CSR: row=receiver dst, column=sender src; complete support; indices int64
schema.R_P_runtime_weight: saved original float32 map weights; no extra normalization
schema.edge_length: norm(delta_xyz), same original characteristic_length_mm for all levels
schema.runtime_xyz: xyz0/xyz1/xyz2 float32; coarse mass-weighted centers in same canonical frame
schema.role_semantics: support-reference DOF/load-interface membership, not nodal Dirichlet; P may mix signatures as original helper records

API.prepare_data: prepare_data(plan_path=DEFAULT_PLAN)->completed manifest; only root after training_rules_frozen and all three source pins
API.read_cache_metadata: read_cache_metadata(plan_path=DEFAULT_PLAN,*,contract=None)->manifest; completed feasibility_pass true and exact contract/files stat required
API.load_hierarchy: load_hierarchy(records[cad],device)->xyz0/xyz1/xyz2 plus W0/W1/W2/R01/R12/P12/P01 maps; sparse CSR receivers rows/senders columns

field_edge_contract.length: float32[E,1] norm(delta), same normalized-L frame all levels
field_edge_contract.csr: torch sparse_csr_tensor float32; full original support and same weight
field_edge_contract.W_weight: original cut multiplicity divided by receiver weighted degree, FP64->FP32; isolated rows have no entries and field applies its declared LN(dst), no identity claim
field_edge_contract.R_P_weight: saved complete original float32 map data, no extra normalization
field_edge_contract.source_geometry: all original cells10 nodes, true corner-mid subedges, no RBE shortcut/fullcorner-P1 alias
field_edge_contract.activations: No E32 or latent cache; delta/length computed when hierarchy loaded

source_scope.hard_maximum: Current level node count computed separately at each owner call; role component lower bound retained; variable N1/N2
source_scope.legacy_reuse: Only same entire source identity/helper SHA/soft-target metadata; root actual validates legacy NPZ SHA and copies input-only cache bytes. Original unused owner caps do not enter selection; original facts retained/disclosed, no new proof or pre-array review
source_scope.P_resource_bound: Existing helper can return scientific completed-negative if full support exceeds its64*N guard; never cuts or topk supports
source_scope.negative_vs_corrupt: ScientificBlock->completed feasibility_pass=false preserving partial records/evidence; read_cache rejects downstream. Other exception->failed

limitations: Input topology and volume/10 mass proxy are not stiffness/solver accuracy evidence
Roles are reference/interface membership, not nodal Dirichlet; full smoothed P records role mixing
No reference strain/scaler fit/rawH5/deck/oldfinal/newtest/dia input access
First actual complete input preparation and first model full-case backward belong only to root sole queue
